and (b.CREDIT_TAG_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{initValue}),'%') OR b.CREDIT_TAG_ID like concat(concat('%', #{initValue}),'%') OR b.APPRO_ID like concat(concat('%', #{initValue}),'%') )

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID id, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
